sentence: Fake reviews mislead shoppers on Indian e-commerce sites, and many of them are written in Hinglish rather than English.
We collected 4,200 reviews from two shopping platforms, labelled them with the help of three annotators, and fine-tuned a multilingual transformer to flag likely fake reviews.
Our best model reached an F1 score of 0.83 on fake reviews.
Because shoppers rely heavily on reviews when deciding what to buy, sellers have a reason to publish fabricated ones.
Indian users of social media and online stores often switch between two languages in the middle of a sentence.
